faqs.q: Sec. 78-32. - Consideration of arguments of persons heard.
faqs.a:
After a provisional order hearing has been concluded, after all written complaints,
               protests and objections have been read and duly considered and after all persons desiring
               to be heard in person have been heard, the council shall consider the arguments, if
               any, and any other relevant material put forth.
(Code 1981, § 27-33; Ord. No. 551, § 14(B), 5-14-1964)
